@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Stronger mark for the current search hit in rendered text (EditorKit search.currentMatch color)
+---
+Found in ^yxxnx1f (D207 (f)).
+
+Now: AVK gives the first match of the current hit the EditorKit style key `SearchDecorations.currentMatchStyle` ("search.currentMatch"), and each other match `SearchDecorations.matchStyle` ("search.match"), through `.editorMarks(_:)`. At EditorKit 8a5a1c2f, `HighlightStyle.markStorageAttributes(for:theme:)` (EditorSwiftUI/HighlightStyle.swift) paints both keys with `theme.selection`. Thus the current hit does not look stronger in an EditorView. `Theme` also has no find-highlight color (D110 (e)).
+
+Blocked: waits for editorkit-7a (asked 2026-11-19): paint "search.currentMatch" stronger than "search.match", with find-highlight colors in `Theme` if possible.
+
+Do, when the EditorKit commit is on main:
+- Update the EditorKit pin in the root, IntegrationTests and ScreenshotTests.
+- Check that the AVK marks use the theme find highlight, with a stronger current match. Change nothing in AVK if the keys are enough.
+- Add a unit test if EditorKit gives a headless check of the two colors.
+
+Run `swift test`. Push, and send the sha to testudoapp-9a.
\ No newline at end of file
